name: Exp_AnchoredMomentum
summary: This EA trades based on the Anchored Momentum custom indicator, opening buy positions when momentum crosses above the upper level and sell positions when it crosses below the lower level. It uses a custom indicator handle with configurable SMA/EMA periods and threshold levels for signal generation. Position sizing uses a deposit share mechanism with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit in points.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Anchored Momentum自定义指标进行交易，当动量突破上轨时开多仓，跌破下轨时开空仓。使用可配置的SMA/EMA周期和阈值水平生成信号，仓位管理采用存款比例机制并配合固定的止损止盈点数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于锚定动量指标（Anchored Momentum）的突破交易。入场条件为：当指标值从上方穿越上轨（UpLevel=+0.025）时产生买入信号，当指标值从下方穿越下轨（DnLevel=-0.025）时产生卖出信号，采用的是穿越确认而非单纯阈值判断，避免假信号。出场条件包括：持有多头时指标跌破下轨则平多仓，持有空头时指标升破上轨则平空仓，同时每笔交易设有固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数实现。策略使用新K线检测机制（IsNewBar）来避免同根K线重复交易，但也允许SignalBar=0时逐tick执行。默认H4周期配合动量指标，属于中长线动量突破策略。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on breakthrough trading using the Anchored Momentum indicator. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the indicator value crosses above the upper level (UpLevel=+0.025) from below, and a sell signal is generated when the indicator value crosses below the lower level (DnLevel=-0.025) from above, using crossover confirmation rather than simple threshold comparison to avoid false signals. Exit conditions include: closing long positions when the indicator falls below the lower level while holding long, and closing short positions when the indicator rises above the upper level while holding short, with each trade also having fixed Stop Loss (1000 points) and Take Profit (2000 points). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share-based lot calculation. Money management relies on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen for execution. The strategy uses a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated trades on the same bar, but also allows tick-by-tick execution when SignalBar=0. With a default H4 timeframe and momentum indicator, this is a medium-to-long-term momentum breakout strategy.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or fixed lot size

parameters.name: InpInd_Timeframe
parameters.description: 锚定动量指标的时间周期

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 指标计算应用价格类型
parameters.description_en: Applied price type for indicator calculation

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用穿越确认机制（Value[1]>UpLevel且Value[0]<=UpLevel）而非简单阈值判断，减少假信号
提供完整的买卖开平仓权限控制，可灵活配置只买、只卖或双向交易
新K线检测机制避免同根K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基本的风险控制框架
指标参数和时间周期均可配置，策略适应性较强
pros_en: Uses crossover confirmation (Value[1]>UpLevel and Value[0]<=UpLevel) rather than simple threshold, reducing false signals
Provides complete buy/sell open/close permission controls for flexible unidirectional or bidirectional trading
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Configurable Stop Loss and Take Profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
Indicator parameters and timeframe are all configurable, offering good strategy adaptability
cons: 依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库和自定义指标AnchoredMomentum，缺少这些文件EA无法运行
止损止盈值较大（1000/2000点）且无动态调整机制，可能不适应当前市场波动率
缺少点差过滤和波动率过滤，在窄幅盘整市场中可能产生大量虚假信号
指标句柄创建失败时仅打印警告但OnInit仍返回0（成功），应返回INIT_FAILED
无最大持仓数限制和回撤控制，极端行情下风险敞口不可控
cons_en: Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library and custom AnchoredMomentum indicator; EA cannot run without these files
Large fixed SL/TP values (1000/2000 points) with no dynamic adjustment mechanism may not suit current market volatility
Lacks spread filter and volatility filter, which may generate numerous false signals in narrow ranging markets
Indicator handle creation failure only prints a warning but OnInit still returns 0 (success) instead of INIT_FAILED
No maximum position limit or drawdown control, leaving risk exposure uncontrolled during extreme market conditions
improvements: OnInit中指标句柄创建失败时应返回INIT_FAILED而非0，防止EA在无指标情况下运行
增加点差过滤和ATR波幅过滤，避免在低流动性或窄幅盘整时产生虚假信号
增加最大持仓数限制和最大回撤保护，提升极端行情下的风险控制能力
improvements_en: OnInit should return INIT_FAILED instead of 0 when indicator handle creation fails, preventing EA from running without the indicator
Add spread filter and ATR volatility filter to avoid false signals during low liquidity or narrow ranging conditions
Add maximum position count limit and maximum drawdown protection to improve risk control during extreme market conditions

risk_points: 指标句柄创建失败时EA仍继续运行，可能导致交易逻辑完全失效
无点差过滤，高点差环境下止损可能被瞬间触发
固定止损止盈不适应市场波动率变化，可能在剧烈行情中造成过大损失
SignalBar=0时逐tick执行可能在高波动时频繁开平仓
risk_points_en: EA continues running when indicator handle creation fails, potentially causing complete trading logic failure
No spread filter means Stop Loss could be triggered instantly in high-spread environments
Fixed SL/TP does not adapt to market volatility changes, potentially causing oversized losses in volatile conditions
Tick-by-tick execution when SignalBar=0 may cause frequent open/close in high volatility

It uses a custom indicator handle with configurable SMA/EMA periods and threshold levels for signal generation. Position sizing uses a deposit share mechanism with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit in points.
